name: Memoket
description:
Memoket MCP connects your meeting recordings to Claude so you can ask questions about conversations you've already captured. Once connected, Claude can pull up your list of recordings, retrieve auto-generated summaries with key points and takeaways, and reference full transcripts to answer questions grounded in exactly what was said.
The connector is read-only: it can find and read your existing recordings, transcripts, and summaries, but it cannot create, edit, or delete anything in your Memoket account. It exposes three retrieval tools — list recordings, get summaries, and get transcripts.
Connection uses a browser-based OAuth sign-in to your Memoket account — no API keys to manage. Your data is accessed only when a question requires it, and the server is designed to redact sensitive details such as payment card numbers, government IDs, credentials, and health information before any content is returned. You can revoke access at any time from Claude's connector settings or your Memoket account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Memoket to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Memoket to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.memoket.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Memoket MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Memoket provides these MCP tools: get_summaries, get_transcripts, list_conversations, search_recordings, get_brief, get_transcripts_by_participant, and get_conversations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Memoket?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Memoket in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Memoket requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Memoket is developed by Memoket.Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
